# Attack Explorer

> Visual Cyber Attack, Log & Malware Analyzer mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

Attack Explorer is an interactive forensic simulation and security analysis web platform designed for security engineers, SOC analysts, DFIR investigators, and red/blue teams.

## Core Capabilities
- **Attack Simulation:** Step-by-step visual execution of real-world adversary scenarios across Workstation, Domain Controller, and Cloud environments.
- **Log Forensics:** Live Sysmon, Windows Event Log, and SIEM packet breakdown with correlated Sigma detection rules.
- **Behavioral Mapping:** Direct mapping to the MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques (TTPs).
- **Process Memory Inspection:** Process hollowing, VAD memory forensics, and AMSI / ETW bypass flowcharts.

## Key Scenarios Included
- [Process Hollowing & Portable Executable Injection (T1055.012)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/process-hollowing)
- [Ransomware Volume Shadow Copy Wipe & Encryption (T1490, T1486)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/ransomware-shadow-wipe)
- [Log4Shell JNDI Remote Code Execution & DFIR Investigation (T1190, CVE-2021-44228)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/log4shell-dfir)
- [Active Directory Kerberoasting & Service Ticket Extraction (T1558.003)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/ad-kerberoasting)
- [DNS Tunneling Covert Command & Control & Data Exfiltration (T1071.004, T1048)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/dns-tunneling-exfil)
- [AMSI Bypass & Reflective DLL Memory Injection (T1562.001, T1620)](https://attackexplorer.org/scenarios/amsi-reflective-dll)
